statements.t: Our primary financial objective has been and remains creating revenue growth from sustainable sources, at target levels of profitability.

Our primary financial objective is not to maximize short-term profits, but rather to achieve target levels of profitability while investing in various growth initiatives, as we continue to believe we are in the early stages of a large, long-term market opportunity.
Through a vertical focus, targeted media presence and our technology platform, we are able to deliver targeted, measurable marketing results to our clients.

One of the primary challenges of our business is finding or creating media that is high quality and targeted enough to attract prospects for our clients at costs that provide a sound financial outcome for us.
In order to grow our business, we must be able to find, develop, or acquire and retain quality targeted media on a cost-effective basis.
We deliver targeted and measurable results through a vertical focus, which includes our financial services client vertical and our home services client vertical.

As of the second quarter of fiscal year 2026, due to the preponderance of positive evidence, including our projected cumulative profit before taxes and future forecasts of continued profitability for the United States, we determined that sufficient positive evidence existed to conclude that substantially all of our valuation allowance was no longer needed and that it is more likely than not that we would be able…
As of September 30, 2026, we continue to conclude that it is more likely than not that these deferred tax assets will be realized.

As of September 30, 2026, our principal sources of liquidity consisted of cash and cash equivalents of $141.5 million, cash we expect to generate from future operations, and our $150.0 million Revolving Credit Facility, from which we have drawn $70.0 million.

Even though we may not need additional funds to fund anticipated liquidity requirements, we may still elect to obtain additional debt financing, issue additional equity securities or draw down on or increase our borrowing capacity under our current revolving credit facility for other reasons.

statements.t: “We plan and expect to be a critical player in ‘AI channels’, providing the compliance, channel integrity, marketing optimization, and, as always, unsurpassed media efficiency at scale necessary to make the channels maximally productive for our clients, just as we do in other areas of digital media.”
“Turning to our outlook, we expect revenue in fiscal Q2 to be between $360 and $380 million, and adjusted EBITDA to be between $32 and $33 million.
“We are raising our outlook for full fiscal year 2027.
We now expect full fiscal year 2027 revenue to be between $1.5 and $1.6 billion, and full fiscal year adjusted EBITDA to be between $155 and $165 million.
We will continue to refine our outlook as the year progresses,” concluded Valenti.
The webcast of the conference call will be available live and via replay on the investor relations section of the Company's website at http://investor.quinstreet.com .

With respect to our adjusted EBITDA guidance, the Company is not able to provide a quantitative reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure without unreasonable efforts due to the high variability, complexity and low visibility with respect to certain items such as taxes, and income and expense from changes in fair value of contingent consideration from acquisitions.

We expect the variability of these items to have a potentially unpredictable and potentially significant impact on future GAAP financial results, and, as such, we also believe that any reconciliations provided would imply a degree of precision that would be confusing or misleading to investors.

We intend to provide these non-GAAP financial measures as part of our future earnings discussions and, therefore, the inclusion of these non-GAAP financial measures will provide consistency in our financial reporting.
Additional information will also be set forth in the Company's quarterly report on Form 10-Q for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, which will be filed with the SEC.
